title: Yocan Ziva Pro 510 Battery⁸
description:
The Yocan Ziva Pro Vaporizer is an auto-draw vape, activating the heating element when you inhale, eliminating the need for buttons. With a reliable 650mAh battery and USB Type-C charging, it offers long-lasting use and fast charging capabilities, ensuring convenience and portability. Its durable aluminum body maintains its premium appearance over time, while features like magnetic connections and an OLED screen enhance usability and maintenance, making it an ideal choice for both beginners and experienced users.

Product Features:
– 650mAh Battery Capacity
– Variable Voltage Setting
– Aluminum Body
– USB Type-C Charging Technology
– OLED Screen
– Magnetic Connections

What’s Included:
1 x Ziva Pro Vaporizer
